case: The same three reviewed negatives over the disk; then the disk's broad extraction failed, with why (its programs are not in the job image).
design: docs/adr/0013 'A source's broad extraction before a negative on it': produced, partial, failed or declined releases the hold; a failed extraction says why on its receipt, and the hold is a wait on work under way, never a demand that it succeed.
docs/adr/0013 the same section: a negative on a source whose broad extraction has not produced is warned (preparation_missing), held ones included once released, and a warning never holds.
docs/adr/0013 'The end of a run': not determinable and a bounded negative are dispositions under every stop policy.
